response:
Low | Check the cable. |

## 8. Abnormal handling

Bad PV and probe loss are in FR-BR500-102 to 104, FR-BR500-201 and IL-05 to IL-06.

**Table 8.1: Fail positions** (provisional until OI-04 closes)

| Device | Loss of signal | Loss of power | Loss of comms |
|---|---|---|---|
| FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 | Closed | Closed | Closed |
| P-520 | Stopped | Stopped | Stopped |
| SIC-530 | Hold last speed | Stopped | Hold last speed |

| ID | Requirement | OQ test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-403 | Each device goes to its Table 8.1 position on each loss. | Remove the signal, power and comms of each device in turn. Verify the position. |
| FR-BR500-404 | On comms loss to a device, the module raises AL-15 or AL-16 and keeps the other devices running. | Disconnect one device. Verify the alarm and the other outputs. |
| FR-BR500-405 | After a controller restart in an active phase, both loops go to RESTART-WAIT with safe outputs. They return to AUTO only through SEQ-3. | Power-cycle the controller in Production. Verify the state, outputs and prompt. |
| FR-BR500-406 | The base total survives controller restart and power loss. | Add base. Power-cycle. Compare the totals. |
| FR-BR500-407 | After restart, the base total is the greater of the stored value and the WT-521 calculation. | Make the stored value lower, then higher, than the WT-521 value. Verify the result. |
| FR-BR500-408 | The batch record keeps the setpoint and mode state through restart. | Compare the values before and after restart. |

## Decisions that need your confirmation first

- **Base limit stop point:** P-520 stops at BASE_LIMIT minus BASE_STOP_MARGIN, so pump overrun cannot push the total above 40 L. The stop latches until the next batch, and no operator can reset it.
- **Hold, Stop and Abort:** these do not disable control, because an uncontrolled culture is at risk (OI-05).
- **Restart:** control resumes only after an operator acknowledges, not automatically (SEQ-3).
- **Setpoint records:** the reason requirement covers pH SP, pH deadband, DO SP and SP limits. It also covers PV-source changes in Production, which is an addition to your QA requirement (OI-06).
